comment:
## Automated AI review

> **Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

**Outcome:** The review found a regression in the theme switcher filter. The Transition drawer saves a setting that nothing reads. The selected preview now decodes the full original image synchronously in every picker. Suggested changes follow, most of them small.

**Verified** (reviewed head `f64b3160`):
- `BackgroundMedia.qml` shows the expected slice at Left, 25%, Center and Right. At Center the output is pixel-identical to the base `PreserveAspectCrop` rendering, so unconfigured backgrounds keep their framing. This was checked by pixel sampling a synthetic four-band image in an offscreen Qt 6.11 render.
- The desktop (`Background.qml`) and lock screen (`LockView.qml`) resolve the alignment with the same `positionFor` lookup on the same resolved background path. Quickshell 0.3.1 `FileView` with `watchChanges` keeps watching after the file is created or replaced, so both re-align after Enter.
- The generated jq save command quotes paths containing spaces and single quotes correctly. It creates the config file when missing, keeps existing entries, and still writes the selection and done files. This was run in a synthetic home.

### Theme switcher filter drops `a` and `t`

The new `Qt.Key_A` and `Qt.Key_T` branches in `ImagePicker.qml` `Keys.onPressed` match whether or not alignment is shown. In a filterable picker `showAlignment` is false, so the branch does nothing. Control never reaches the later printable-character branch that appends to the filter.

```text
theme switcher filter, typed with real key events (QtTest, offscreen)
typed              base               head
tokyo-night        tokyo-night        okyo-nigh
matte-black        matte-black        me-blck
rose-pine          rose-pine          rose-pine   (no a/t, control)
```

**Impact:** `omarchy-theme-switcher` passes `--filterable`, so typing a theme name containing `a` or `t` into its filter loses those letters.

**Suggested change:** move the guard into the condition, as the Up/Down branches already do: `else if (root.showAlignment && event.key === Qt.Key_A)`, and the same for `Qt.Key_T`.

### Transition drawer setting has no consumer

The drawer writes `~/.config/omarchy/background-slideshow.json` on each step, and the status shelf shows the chosen interval. No code in this PR or on current `quattro` reads that file or rotates backgrounds. `Background.qml` has no timer, and `omarchy-theme-bg-next` runs only when invoked, so in source nothing acts on a chosen interval such as `1m`.

**Impact:** the control implies slideshow rotation that does not happen.

**Suggested change:** implement the rotation (for example a timer in the background plugin that reads this file and calls the existing next-background path), or leave the Transition drawer out of this PR.

### Selected preview decodes the full original synchronously in every picker

At base, the selected card showed the cached `1536x864` thumbnail from `omarchy-menu-images`. At head, a new `fullImage` loads `item.filePath` with `asynchronous: false` and no `sourceSize`. It is not gated on `showAlignment`, so the theme and Plymouth pickers are affected as well.

```text
main-thread load per selection change (offscreen Qt 6.11, software renderer, one host)
bundled background                          original (head)   thumbnail (base)
gruvbox 1-the-backwater.jpg  4096x2428     50-57 ms          4-5 ms
tokyo-night 3-sunset-lake.webp 7680x3215   70-77 ms          2-3 ms
retro-82 5-zen-boat.webp  10456x3455       156-160 ms        3 ms
```

71 of the 92 bundled backgrounds are 8 MP or larger. The timings cover decoding only and come from a single machine.

**Impact:** main-thread stalls on each selection change while stepping through the carousel, largest for the biggest bundled backgrounds.

**Suggested change:** keep the thumbnail visible and load the original with `asynchronous: true` over it. An alternative is an aspect-preserving cached preview generated with vips alongside the existing thumbnails. A bounded `sourceSize` roughly halved JPEG cost but did not help WebP in the measurement, and most bundled backgrounds are WebP.

### Saved alignment can be shown and saved as Center after reopening (ordering-dependent)

On the new-rows open path, `openSelector()` sets `opened = true`, which reloads the alignments file, and defers `loadRows()` with `Qt.callLater`. `loadRows()` sets `selectedIndex` before assigning `imageArray`, and nothing recomputes `currentStepIndex` once `imageArray` changes.

```text
opened = true      -> alignmentsFile.reload(); step computed on empty rows = Center
FileView loaded    -> loadAlignments() recomputes, rows still empty = Center
loadRows()         -> selectedIndex set, then imageArray set; no recompute
Enter              -> saves "center" for an image stored as "left"
```

This sequence was reproduced with the unmodified picker and stubbed Quickshell runtime pieces. When the file load completes after `loadRows()`, the saved value shows correctly. The real ordering inside Quickshell was not established.

**Impact:** when the file loads first, a saved Left/Right alignment appears as Center, and pressing Enter overwrites it.

**Suggested change:** call `updateCurrentAlignment()` after `imageArray` is assigned (or in `onImageArrayChanged`). Consider writing an alignment only when the user changed it.

### Alignment keys are shared across themes

The save writes two keys: the basename and the picker path. The picker path is `~/.local/state/omarchy/current/theme/backgrounds/<name>`. `omarchy-theme-set` copies every theme into that same `current/theme` directory, so both keys collide for same-named backgrounds in different themes. For example, 18 bundled themes ship different `omarchy.webp` files. Setting Left in one theme applies Left to a same-named background in another theme instead of the Center default.

**Impact:** a same-named background in another theme takes an alignment set elsewhere instead of the Center default, and setting it there overwrites the first theme's value.

**Suggested change:** key alignments per theme (for example theme name plus filename), similar to the per-theme wallpaper memory recently added to `omarchy-theme-set` on `quattro`.

### Lock screen decodes wallpapers at fit size, then upscales

`BackgroundMedia.qml` drops `fillMode: Image.PreserveAspectCrop` but keeps both `sourceSize` dimensions when `version > 0`, which is the lock screen path. Without the crop fill mode, Qt decodes to fit inside the box, and the new scale factor then enlarges it to cover. In an offscreen measurement, a 1920x540 image in a 960x540 item decoded at 960x270, against 1920x540 at base. The lock screen blur hides most of the loss.

**Impact:** lock screen wallpapers are decoded at reduced resolution and upscaled; the blur largely hides the difference.

**Suggested change:** keep `fillMode: Image.PreserveAspectCrop` on the inner `Image`. The item is already sized to the cover size, so the layout is unchanged and the decode returns to cover size.

### Smaller notes

- **Escape:** the PR description says Escape closes the open drawer first. The Escape branch is unchanged, so with a drawer open it calls `cancel()`, which closes the picker and discards the unsaved alignment.
- **Preview versus screen:** the preview crops against the 768x475 card (about 1.62:1), not the monitor. For a 16:9 image on a 16:9 monitor, the preview moves between steps but the desktop cannot change. 55 of the 92 bundled backgrounds are 16:9. Computing the preview crop against the target screen's aspect ratio, or showing the controls only when the image is wider than the screen, would keep them consistent.
- **Video entries:** `showAlignment` excludes videos, and `bottomChromeHeight` drops from 142 to 30 px on a video entry. The card jumps and the tabs and status shelf disappear. Reserving the chrome height in the background picker and disabling the controls on videos would avoid the jump.
- **Documentation:** the test plan lists `test/shell.d/qml-text-format-test.sh` as updated, but that file is not in the diff. It passes unmodified.

## Review information

**Test scope:** Source review of all seven changed files and their callers on `quattro` (theme switcher, `omarchy-menu-images`, `omarchy-theme-set`, lock service), plus Quickshell 0.3.1 and qtdeclarative 6.11.2 source. Isolated runs used offscreen Qt 6.11 with the software renderer and synthetic homes. The picker ran unmodified with stubbed Quickshell runtime pieces. No live desktop, quickshell binary or visual check of the tab and shelf layout was used, and the repository's node-based shell tests were not run. Timings are decode-only from one machine.

**AI process:** Opus 5.5 Medium coordination and synthesis; independent Opus 5.5 Xhigh and GPT 6 Sol Xhigh technical assessments, with a targeted follow-up to cross-check single-source claims; Opus 5.5 Medium editorial check.

**Opt out:** To stop receiving these reviews, reply to this comment saying so.
